name: turbo-flutter-log
description: Automating the process of writing meaningful log messages in flutter.

enumDescriptions: dart:core print(). No import needed, which is why it is the default. Always printed, including in release builds.
Flutter debugPrint(). Throttled so long output is not dropped by the platform. Adds package:flutter/foundation.dart when no Flutter library already provides it.
dart:developer log(). Carries the enclosing symbol as name: and the level as level:, and adds its prefixed import automatically.
turbo-flutter-log.logFunction.description: Which Dart logging call to insert.

turbo-flutter-log.logLevel.description: Severity of inserted logs. Written into the message, and passed as level: when using developer.log.

turbo-flutter-log.marker.markdownDescription: Identifies logs inserted by this extension, so the comment, uncomment and delete commands never touch a hand-written log. Must not be empty and must not contain `'`, `"`, `\` or `$`; an invalid value falls back to the default. Changing it orphans logs already inserted under the old marker.

turbo-flutter-log.quote.description: Quote style for the message literal.

turbo-flutter-log.includeFileName.description: Include the file name in the message.

turbo-flutter-log.includeLineNumber.description: Append the line number to the file name. Ignored when the file name is not included.

turbo-flutter-log.includeEnclosingClass.description: Include the enclosing class name. Requires the Dart extension; the segment is dropped when no symbol provider answers.

turbo-flutter-log.includeEnclosingFuncti.description: Include the enclosing function or method name. Requires the Dart extension; the segment is dropped when no symbol provider answers.

turbo-flutter-log.insertEmptyLineBefore.description: Insert a blank line before the log statement.

turbo-flutter-log.insertEmptyLineAfter.description: Insert a blank line after the log statement.

turbo-flutter-log.developerLogAlias.markdownDescription: Import prefix used for `dart:developer`. An alias already present in the file wins over this setting. Must be a Dart identifier; an invalid value falls back to the default.

commands.title: Turbo Flutter Log: Display Log Message
Turbo Flutter Log: Comment All Log Messages

Turbo Flutter Log: Delete All Log Messages

scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
